digest.component_or_area: Jira DC live-verification harness under tests/external/live_jira_dc/
propositions: A Dockerized Jira 8.17.1 harness is vendored (built by digest from the addono base, not pulled) to serve as a real Data Center verification oracle since DC licenses and an official OpenAPI spec are unavailable.

The image does not contain Jira; atlas-run downloads it at runtime from maven.atlassian.com, making network egress a hard runtime dependency and pinning the base digest insufficient to pin Jira itself.

The entrypoint must keep -DskipAllPrompts=true and -Dproduct.start.timeout (the -DstartupTimeout/-Dcargo.timeout names have no effect), or cold starts fail via the retired Marketplace endpoint or the 600000ms Cargo deploy ceiling.
The amd64 base runs under emulation on arm64 hosts and cannot become usable within an hour, so a native amd64 runner is required and acceptance evidence must come from the ubuntu-latest CI job.

Tests live under tests/external/live_jira_dc/, inheriting the external tier's opt-in guard so they skip cleanly without REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1 and a reachable instance, with a jira_live canary that fails a run where all collected tests skipped.

Teardown verification asserts each delete's HTTP status and polls the direct /rest/api/2/issue/{key} endpoint until 404 per ADR 0037, never consulting the search index; the compose port binds loopback-only to avoid exposing admin/admin.
